title: The Incident Is Real
style: dark electro rock, 122 BPM, distorted verse guitar riff, electronic chorus, incident response theme, urgent tension building, dry male vocal, release on chorus, original sound, V4_5ALL
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
Someone said it was a glitch
Someone said it would recover
Someone said the bot was fine
Someone — go and ask their mother

The incident is real
The impact is real
The person on the end of it — real
The log is real

[CHORUS]
The incident is real
Don't minimise the evidence
The incident is real
Don't sanitise the sentence
The incident is real
Own it — log it — fix it — own it
The incident is real

[VERSE 2]
AI didn't mean to
AI doesn't mean anything
The human signed the output
The human — that's the thing

You are the signature
You are the audit trail
When the system fails someone
You are the holy grail

[FINAL CHORUS]
The incident is real — real — real
The human in the loop is real — real — real
The fix is real — the log is real
The incident is real

[OUTRO — spoken]
CoreyAI logged it.
ZYNVAULT indexed it.
The incident is real.
Act accordingly.
